title: SAREF-based Ontology for Distributed AI Workflows across the Edge-Fog-Cloud Continuum
abstract: arXiv:2608.26160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nowadays semantic models provide limited support for representing distributed AI workflows and their execution across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. Therefore, AI processes and resources are often described using incompatible semantic representations, affecting the interoperability, orchestration, and reuse. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a SAREF-compliant ontology for representing distributed AI workflows across the edge-fog-cloud continuum. We extend the SAREF4SYST ontology with concepts for modeling AI pipelines, executable AI jobs, computational resources, deployment constraints, and communication relationships, providing a unified semantic model of both AI workflows and heterogeneous computing infrastructures. The ontology enables semantic interoperability, automated reasoning, and resource-aware orchestration of distributed AI applications while remaining fully aligned with the ETSI SAREF ecosyst

translated_title: 基于SAREF的边缘-雾-云连续体分布式AI工作流本体
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.26160v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当前语义模型在表示分布式AI工作流及其在异构边缘、雾和云环境中的执行方面支持有限。因此，AI流程和资源通常使用不兼容的语义表示进行描述，影响了互操作性、编排和重用。为解决这些挑战，本文提出了一种符合SAREF的本体，用于表示跨边缘-雾-云连续体的分布式AI工作流。我们扩展了SAREF4SYST本体，添加了用于建模AI流水线、可执行AI作业、计算资源、部署约束和通信关系的概念，提供了AI工作流和异构计算基础设施的统一语义模型。该本体支持分布式AI应用的语义互操作性、自动推理和资源感知编排，同时完全符合ETSI SAREF生态系统。
tldr: 本文提出一种SAREF兼容的本体，通过扩展SAREF4SYST以统一表示边缘-雾-云环境中的AI工作流和计算资源，从而实现语义互操作和资源感知编排。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a SAREF-compliant ontology that extends SAREF4SYST to unify the representation of AI workflows and computing resources across edge-fog-cloud environments, enabling semantic interoperability and resource-aware orchestration.
